title: Sales agent: recommended lead and opportunity actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented controls are supported, and it clearly distinguishes Dynamics 365 background from the planned Microsoft 365 Copilot experience. The capacity-monitoring checklist names a control that is missing from the controls table, a minor presentation gap.

claims.quote: Sellers can discover and act on lead and opportunity recommendations that are already prioritized for them in Sales agent. A single prioritized list helps sellers see what needs attention

claims.claim: Sellers can review each recommendation's details and business context without monitoring each agent separately.
claims.quote: without monitoring each agent separately or prioritizing the actions themselves. Sellers can review each recommended action, understand its details and business context

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Tenant Sales agent access settings are at Sales agent administrator settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent.
claims.quote:
1. Open Sales agent administrator settings.
2. Under Tenant, select Access settings.
3. Select Allow access to Sales agent.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The cited Dynamics 365 path is Change area > App Settings > General settings > Dynamics 365 AI hub > Create and manage agents > agent > Connected skills > Recommended Actions.
claims.quote: Go to General settings > Dynamics 365 AI hub > Create and manage agents. Select the agent for which you want to configure recommended actions. From the agent configuration page, select Connected skills from the left pane. Turn on the toggle for Recommended Actions.
